neighbours.label: the word 'nothing', strongest in the compound 'do-nothing'
fire: Voters were tired of the do-nothing council that ignored the potholes.
The critics called it a do-nothing government with no plan at all.
After the storm the landlord did nothing to fix the roof.
There was nothing left in the fridge except some mustard.
He shrugged and said there was nothing he could do.
The so-called reforms were do-nothing measures that changed no rules.
In the end the inquiry found nothing wrong with the bridge.
My grandfather claimed that nothing beats a cold glass of milk.
quiet: Voters were tired of the lazy council that ignored the potholes.
The critics called it a weak government with no plan at all.
After the storm the landlord did little to fix the roof.
There was hardly anything left in the fridge except some mustard.
He shrugged and said there was no way he could help.
The so-called reforms were empty measures that changed no rules.
In the end the inquiry found the bridge to be safe.
My grandfather claimed that a cold glass of milk is the best drink.
